title: An action's confirm dialog is always titled 「确认操作」 with a 「继续」 button — the action's own label and danger variant never reach it
body:
Filing class: ① user-visible defect — reach: public door, measured in a browser on the 18.1.0 Console with objectstack-ai/hotclm `main`, code read on objectstack `main` `1c632311`. **Reader:** the UI lane, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` (`ConfirmationHandler` call) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionConfirmDialog.tsx`.

## Business reason
A confirm dialog is the user's last chance before an irreversible step. hotclm's 撤回 (withdraw a draft) moves the contract to 已作废, a terminal state. The dialog's body says so clearly, but its title is 「确认操作」 and the button is 「继续」, in the neutral style. A user who skims reads "continue" and loses the contract.

## Measured
- 撤回 on a draft (hotclm `withdraw`, `confirmText` declared): title 「确认操作」, buttons 取消 / **继续** (neutral). The same chrome appears for every declared action with a `confirmText`.
- `ActionConfirmDialog.tsx:61` / `:72` fall back to `actionConfirm.title` / `.confirm` whenever `options` is empty. The runner calls the confirmation handler with the message only, so `options` is always empty for a metadata action. Record Delete already passes a title, a confirm label and `destructive` (objectui#11695 / #11744); declared actions do not.

## Expected
Title = the action's label (「撤回」); confirm button = the action's label; destructive styling when the action declares `variant: 'danger'` (or the spec's equivalent). No new metadata key is needed for the default. (hotclm's `withdraw_contract`, `src/actions/contract-lifecycle.actions.ts:188`, does not declare `variant: 'danger'` today because the dialog would not read it; it will once the dialog does.)

Dedupe: objectstack issues (2,000 most recent) and archived objectui issues grepped for `actionConfirm`, `确认操作`, `Continue`, `confirm dialog` — objectui#11695 fixed this for Delete only; objectstack#25637 made `confirmText` a template slot and did not touch the chrome.

---
_Filed from the hotclm UI/UX review (2026-10-27); maintainer: 「平台的问题应该提交issue到平台」._
